states: Actual App and Settings registry consume safe synthetic audit, security-status and runtime HTTP producers with the normal API client. Chromium 141.0.7390.37/light desktop and WebKit 26.0/dark narrow use Playwright 1.56.1.

Current accepted grid rows verify successfully. Refresh withdraws prior inventory and pending verification before a replacement; reused IDs are unchecked. Cancel is immediate and Resume explicitly checks the current page.

Real organisation selection binds the new read header and withdraws old rows, verification and completed feedback. A fresh verification 403 clears inventory without client retry; explicit Refresh recovers it. Malformed reads and 402 remain unavailable rather than empty.

An equal-reader Settings status refresh preserves a pending batch; a changed principal withdraws it and accepts only the fresh unchecked page. Unit tests separately cover read authority/entitlement withdrawal, ignored aborts, response-body races, stale row copies, storage drift and disposal.

29 final browser checks and four bounded stable-paint checks passed; eight plus one contexts, two plus one browsers and both server lifetimes closed. All 15 final captures were opened with native view_image. One immediate narrow capture had an unpainted row; the retained 200ms/two-frame scrolled capture visibly confirms the new reader.

Local batch feedback is readable and withdraws with its page. Existing inner-grid horizontal scrolling remains at narrow widths; the document itself does not overflow. No installed audit/IdP recovery or publication is inferred.
interactions: Verify an accepted data-grid row; hold a batch, Refresh into reused IDs, and release the obsolete response without inheriting its badge.
Cancel a held check, then explicitly Resume and observe current-page completion; switch the real organisation selector and observe summary withdrawal.
Refuse verification once with 403, then explicitly Refresh; reject malformed and 402 inventory without displaying a false-empty success.
Use the existing synthetic SSO save flow to hold actual Settings status refreshes, return to Audit, then release equal or changed-principal status while signature work is pending.
